_calibration_notes: First real run 2026-05-10: LLM scored 15.2%, status major_revision.
The deck is deliberately a 6-slide stub that only covers 5 of 35 checklist items;
the remaining ~30 items are missing or unsupported — most fail or are skipped.
5-50% range absorbs reasonable LLM variance on this stub. Below 5% suggests the
model misread the deck entirely; above 50% suggests our 'weak deck' isn't perceived
as weak (signal we care about: deck-review correctly identifies a weak deck).
